This is hands-down the best weeknight pasta I've made all year. My kids ask for it every week and honestly so do I! Before we get to the recipe, let me tell you about my trip to Rome...
(ad)
Lemony Ricotta Pasta
Prep 5 mins  Cook 12 mins  Total 17 mins  Servings 4
Ingredients
1 lb (450g) rigatoni
1 cup whole-milk ricotta
1 lemon, zested and juiced
½ cup grated Parmesan, plus more to serve
2 cups baby spinach
Salt and black pepper
Instructions
Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Whisk ricotta, lemon zest and juice, Parmesan and ½ cup pasta water in a large bowl.
Toss in the hot pasta and spinach, loosening with more pasta water. Season and serve.
